中文

问题修复
- 修正 0.1.11 引入的本地隧道校验判据:当时要求一次性 token URL 返回 **200**,但 dsh 对有效 token 的应答是 **303**(种下浏览器 cookie 并重定向到干净 URL),已在同一会话中持有 cookie 时才是 200。要求"恰好 200"导致每一个有效本地端口都被判为"不是我们的 dsh":`up` 依次试完 5 个候选端口后报错 `local port N did not serve our dsh (HTTP 303)`。现在 **2xx/3xx 都算"隧道通到我们自己的 dsh"**,只有 401/403(别的实例拒绝了我们的 token)才判定该候选端口不合格
- 已在真实服务器 + dsh 0.1.5-rc.2 上验证:token URL 经隧道返回 303,浏览器跟随重定向后拿到完整 UI(HTTP 200,约 27 KB)

---

English

Bug Fixes
- Corrects the local-tunnel criterion added in 0.1.11: it required HTTP **200** from the one-time token URL, but dsh answers a valid token with **303** (minting the browser cookie and redirecting to the clean URL) and only returns 200 when the cookie is already present. Demanding exactly 200 rejected every valid local port — `up` tried all five candidates and failed with `local port N did not serve our dsh (HTTP 303)`. Any 2xx/3xx now means "this tunnel reaches our own dsh"; only 401/403 (another instance rejecting our token) disqualifies a candidate
- Verified on a real server running dsh 0.1.5-rc.2: the token URL answers 303 through the tunnel, and following the redirect lands on the full UI (HTTP 200, ~27 KB)
